scenarios.title: Compromised camera (all three lanes)
scenarios.description: The walkthrough: one IP camera seen on flows, logs and telemetry at once. Signatures and a threshold corroborate each other; the camera ranks CRITICAL.

scenarios.title: Port scan
scenarios.description: Rate detection on the flow lane: a workstation probing many ports on one host. flow_burst's port_scan preset fires; Network Service Discovery (T1046).

scenarios.title: SSH brute force
scenarios.description: Rate detection on the log lane: repeated failed passwords. log_burst's auth_failure preset fires; Brute Force (T1110).

scenarios.title: Overheating pump
scenarios.description: A telemetry threshold: four readings above 80 °C on one pump become four detections and one alert.

scenarios.title: Quiet network (control)
scenarios.description: Ordinary traffic on all three lanes with every detector switched on. The right answer is nothing: a detector that fires here is a false alarm.

scenarios.title: Broken input
scenarios.description: Four malformed syslog lines are quarantined with a reason rather than dropped. Open Data health after the run to see them.

scenarios.title: Stuck water meter
scenarios.description: A water meter freezes for 48 hours, then jumps to catch up. meter_baseline's written checks flag the freeze and the jump, meter_lof flags both from what it learned of this meter, and meter_iforest stays silent. To compare engines, choose fused in the Alerts step.

scenarios.title: EOA water meters (real data)
scenarios.description: Fifteen months of five real households' water meters. meter_baseline reports unusual use and a stuck meter against each meter's own normal week; most alerts are meter_quality's hourly limit of 0.075 m3, which these households often pass. Hours with no reading, and the hour the clocks went back, are quarantined: see Data health.

scenarios.title: SensiPro water meters (live data)
scenarios.description: Pulls every SensiPro water meter for 27 November to 1 December 2024 from the live database. meter_quality reports meters that went silent or ran over the hourly limit. meter_baseline needs two weeks of a meter's history, so over these five days it skips every meter and says so. Each run stores its results again.

scenarios.title: SensiPro electricity meters (live data)
scenarios.description: Pulls every SensiPro electricity meter for 27 November to 1 December 2024 from the live database, some 750 meters. meter_quality reports meters that went silent or ran over the hourly limit. meter_baseline needs two weeks of a meter's history, so over these five days it skips every meter and says so. Each run stores its results again.

scenarios.title: Biology network flows (live data)
scenarios.description: Pulls the Biology capture for 21 and 22 July 2023 from the live database and judges it with the flow rules and all three burst presets. If the synthetic attack from scripts/biology_fake_attack.py is inserted, this window carries it. Each run stores its results again, which doubles the counts on the IT overview.
